info.title: FoodWise API
info.description: Demand forecasting, student feedback and surplus rescue for college canteens and hostel messes. All tenant data is scoped by the caller's token and enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security.

post.description: Change this account's password. Other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in.

post.description: Development convenience: sign in as a seeded demo account without typing its password.

get.description:
Weekly menu optimiser (heuristic): swap low-rated, high-waste dishes for well-liked dishes of the
same course and diet, without repeating a dish within three days. A manager approves each swap.

get.description:
Server-sent events: one `snapshot` message whenever the surplus changes (and every 5 s),
so a phone in the kitchen and a laptop in the office stay in step.

post.description: Record that a place agreed to take some of the food.
Close the surplus; anything not handed over is recorded as disposed.

Champion health per canteen, and daily live error (WAPE of the median forecast against

Core Web Vitals from browsers (sent with navigator.sendBeacon, so no sign-in header).
Only the metric, the route pattern and the connection type are kept.
